deterministic_rule_findings.title: Manifest Specification Conflict for pydantic
deterministic_rule_findings.description: Discrepancy detected between manifests: requirements.txt specifies '==1.10.13', pyproject.toml specifies '>=2'
deterministic_rule_findings.rationale: Conflicting version specifiers across manifests lead to non-deterministic installation, silent version drift between development and production, and package resolver confusion.
deterministic_rule_findings.suggested_action: Reconcile pydantic version requirements across pyproject.toml and requirements.txt.

deterministic_rule_findings.title: Incompatible Transitive Pairing: Jinja2 2.11.x with Modern MarkupSafe
deterministic_rule_findings.description: Jinja2 2.11.3 pinned in manifests imports 'soft_unicode' from MarkupSafe. Installed MarkupSafe is 3.0.4, which removed 'soft_unicode'.
deterministic_rule_findings.rationale: Causes an immediate runtime ImportError when any template is rendered. This directly causes test_report.py to fail in the baseline environment.

deterministic_rule_findings.title: Pydantic V1/V2 Incompatibility and Specifier Mismatch
deterministic_rule_findings.description: Source code utilizes Pydantic v1 '@validator' and 'class Config' patterns, while pyproject.toml requests 'pydantic>=2' and requirements.txt locks 'pydantic==1.10.13'.
deterministic_rule_findings.rationale: Pydantic v2 deprecates @validator in favor of @field_validator and alters BaseModel.Config. Installing via pyproject.toml without pinning v1 will cause deprecation warnings or validation failures.

deterministic_rule_findings.title: Unmaintained Library: appdirs Pinned at 1.4.4
deterministic_rule_findings.description: appdirs is an abandoned library with no releases since 2017. The Python packaging community has officially standardized on 'platformdirs' as its direct drop-in replacement.
deterministic_rule_findings.rationale: appdirs does not receive bug fixes, security patches, or updates for newer operating systems.

deterministic_rule_findings.title: Deprecated API: pkg_resources Imported Directly
deterministic_rule_findings.description: linkwatch imports pkg_resources to locate template assets. Setuptools has formally deprecated pkg_resources, and it generates a runtime DeprecationWarning.
deterministic_rule_findings.rationale: pkg_resources has slow import overhead and is scheduled for retirement. Standard library 'importlib.resources' (available in Python 3.9+) is the modern, zero-dependency replacement.
deterministic_rule_findings.suggested_action: Replace pkg_resources with importlib.resources.files() from the Python standard library.

deterministic_rule_findings.title: Obsolete Test Framework: nose==1.3.7 Declared in Dev Requirements
deterministic_rule_findings.description: nose is an obsolete test runner discontinued since 2015. It relies on the 'imp' module which was completely removed in Python 3.12, causing nose to fail to even import.
deterministic_rule_findings.rationale: LinkWatch's test suite is written using pytest fixtures and test functions; nose is completely unused.
deterministic_rule_findings.suggested_action: Remove nose==1.3.7 from requirements-dev.txt and rely exclusively on pytest.

deterministic_rule_findings.title: Unreferenced Dependency: six
deterministic_rule_findings.description: six is declared in both requirements.txt and pyproject.toml, but 0 imports were found in the codebase.
deterministic_rule_findings.rationale: Python 2 compatibility shim is unnecessary for a codebase targeting Python >= 3.10. Leaving unused dependencies bloats the install surface and confuses audits.

deterministic_rule_findings.title: Standard Library Modernization Opportunity: toml -> tomllib
deterministic_rule_findings.description: LinkWatch uses the third-party 'toml' package for reading sites.toml. Python 3.11+ includes 'tomllib' in the standard library.
deterministic_rule_findings.rationale: Transitioning to tomllib eliminates an external dependency for reading TOML configurations.
